theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid n)) (u : Euclid n → ℝ) (σ : Measure (Euclid P)) (q : Euclid P → Euclid n) (h : Euclid P → ℝ), IsOpen U → Measurable q → IntegrableOn u U → Integrable h σ → (∀ b : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b → HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ U → ∫ y in U, b y * u y = ∫ x, b (q x) * h x ∂σ) → ∀ B : Set (Euclid n), MeasurableSet B → B ⊆ U → ∫ y in B, u y = ∫ x in q ⁻¹' B, h x ∂σ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
